name: SADC TFCA Financing Facility open calls

funder.name: SADC TFCA Financing Facility (German Government via KfW, with EU NaturAfrica)

administered_by.name: IUCN Eastern and Southern Africa Regional Office

summary: Re-granting facility run by IUCN that funds conservation, habitat connectivity, protected area management and community livelihood projects in Transfrontier Conservation Areas in Southern Africa, through open calls for concept notes.

geography.label: Transfrontier Conservation Areas in Southern Africa

amount.note: Range for the third open call

calls.label: Third open call for concept notes

status.quote: Concept notes must be submitted by 5 PM SAST on 31st March 2026.

deadline.quote: Concept notes must be submitted by 5 PM SAST on 31st March 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible entities include SMEs, cooperatives, NGOs, and public/private sector entities with relevant experience.

geography.quote: aimed at funding sustainable conservation and green economy projects in Transfrontier Conservation Areas in Southern Africa.

access.quote: Our re-granting programme is intended to be flexible and demand-driven, through Calls for Proposals as well as Direct Awards for specific landscapes, as needed.

window.quote: Concept notes must be submitted by 5 PM SAST on 31st March 2026.

amount.quote: Total of €5,700,000 allocated under the EU NaturAfrica funding envelope. Grants range from €300,000 to €950,000 with a minimum of 10% co-financing required.

co_finance_required.quote: Grants range from €300,000 to €950,000 with a minimum of 10% co-financing required.

administered_by.quote: SADC TFCA Financing Facility funds are channelled to TFCAs through a re-granting programme managed by IUCN.
